title: Realms of Revelation Ecclesia — Myrtle Beach

settings.eyebrow: A church where faith becomes life
settings.headline:
Encounter God.
Find your place.
settings.copy: Come as you are and discover a vibrant church family committed to biblical truth, authentic worship, meaningful relationships, and a life of purpose. Under Bishop Marlon Curtis, we gather as the Tribe of Fire — consecrated, Spirit-led, and rooted in God's Word.

settings.image_caption: Bishop Marlon Curtis — Tribe of Fire
settings.title: Make your calling

paragraphs.text: God is preparing His people for the last hour. In a stirring word from 2 Peter 1:10, we are challenged to give diligence to make our calling and election sure — to move beyond religion into a living, consecrated walk in the Holy Spirit.

As the Tribe of Fire, we are called to be doers of the Word, not hearers only — denouncing the works of darkness, standing steadfast and unmovable, and living as a reflection of holiness and righteousness.

settings.quote: "Come and visit us, or join us online — experience the love and grace of God in person. God did not give us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind."

settings.title: You were never meant to walk
settings.intro: Realms Of Revelation Ecclesia is a place to meet God, build genuine relationships, deepen your understanding of Scripture, and become equipped to live with spiritual clarity and purpose.

settings.verse_ref: 2 Corinthians 9:7 — God loves a cheerful giver.

settings.title: Questions,
settings.intro: A few helpful details before you visit. If your question is not here, just get in touch.

items.question: When can I visit?
items.answer: See our service times below for the full weekly schedule. We would love to have you join us.

items.question: Do I need to be a member to attend?
items.answer: No — we invite anyone and everyone to attend. Come and see, and experience the love and grace of God in person.

items.question: Can I watch online?
items.answer: Yes. We broadcast our services live on The Way of Holiness broadcast — find us on YouTube to join the gathering from anywhere.

items.question: What is the Tribe of Fire?
items.answer: Tribe of Fire is our family name for the church — a Spirit-led people who are the elected and selected of God, living consecrated lives and standing firm in the last hour.

items.question: How can I get involved?
items.answer: From prayer and fellowship to serving in the community, there are many ways to grow and serve. Get in touch and we'll help you find your place.

items.question: How do I give?
items.answer: We give from a willing heart, obediently and cheerfully. Get in touch for giving details, or speak with us after a service.

items.question: Where are you located?
items.answer: We are a welcoming church family in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Contact us for directions and service details.

settings.title: We would love to
settings.intro: Tell us you are coming and our team can help make your first visit comfortable, simple, and personal.
settings.form_kicker: Let us know you are coming
